tbesh_html:
1) to disgrace, dishonour, be lightly esteemed, be dishonoured, be despised
1a) (Niphal) to be dishonoured, be despised, be lightly esteemed
1b) (Hiphil) to treat with contempt, dishonour, treat shamefully

strongs_1890.strongs_def: to be light (as implied in rapid motion), but figuratively, only (be (causatively, hold) in contempt)
strongs_1890.kjv_def: base, contemn, despise, lightly esteem, set light, seem vile.
